sections.heading: What Plants Do
sections.body: Plants make their own food. They use sunlight to do this. This process is called photosynthesis.

sections.heading: What Plants Need
sections.body: Plants need sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide. Carbon dioxide is a gas in the air.

sections.heading: What Plants Make
sections.body: Plants make glucose and oxygen. Glucose is sugar. Oxygen is the gas we breathe.

key_terms.definition: how plants make food from sunlight
